summary: The reported scheduler-initialization defect is already fixed in the prepared main checkout. Upstream PR https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/34560 merged commit 41cd5a718942f97bc45b0b5d7fca82992e8ae529 on 2026-08-14 and explicitly addresses the reported AttributeError. Current code both synchronizes Qwen3.5 MTP depth into hf_text_config and unwraps HybridLinearKVPool to full_kv_pool before reading layer_num. The existing failing-before/passing-after regressions and additional independent boundary checks pass, so no duplicate source correction was made.

tests.what_was_measured: 14 tests and 4 subtests passed, including Qwen3.5 nested text-config MTP normalization, the issue-shaped HybridLinearKVPool-without-layer_num regression, empty draft handling, and host logical-space sizing. Raw output: reports/j-207f562ceaa8/evidence/focused_tests.log

Independent checks covered an empty hybrid wrapper, a non-empty hybrid wrapper, and a non-empty plain pool; all passed and the hybrid sidecar used the inner full_kv_pool. Raw output: reports/j-207f562ceaa8/evidence/draft_pool_boundary_check.log

Environment inventory only: one AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, HIP 7.2.26015. This did not execute the affected model or qualify the serving path. Raw output: reports/j-207f562ceaa8/evidence/gpu_inventory.log

gpu_execution.evidence: The assigned single gfx950 GPU was inventoried, but no issue-valid GPU execution was possible or necessary for the Python attribute-access regression. No GPU smoke is claimed as model-level evidence.

remaining_limitations: The reported Qwen3.5-class model weights were not available locally.
The original multi-rank production topology was not reproduced on the assigned single GPU.
No full-model performance or semantic-accuracy claim is made.
Historical failure evidence comes from the exact pre-fix source and merged upstream PR record; the prepared current checkout no longer reproduces the AttributeError.
